Pricing

Pricing information for Verity

Verity is designed to keep the core experience generous while charging for resource-intensive or optional capabilities where applicable.

Payment Philosophy

"Pay for what you use." The core document and record management experience is free to use, while resource-processing capabilities and high-capacity storage tiers are subject to straightforward, predictable pricing.

Important Note: Verity is a dedicated receipt and expense management platform, not a generic cloud storage provider. Storage capacity is strictly allocated and paid for within our tiers to prevent system resource abuse and ensure high performance for all users.

Base Plans

Each plan provides plenty of storage space tailored to its target audience. In the unlikely scenario where you need more, contact us for solutions.

Free Plan

Designed for personal use and basic tracking.

  • 500.0 MB secure cloud storage
  • 15 quick scans per month
  • Supporting file uploads (Up to 5 MB per file)
  • Record expiry reminders

Verity Pro

Manage purchases, receipts, supporting documents, warranties, and reimbursements all in one place.

  • All free plan features included
  • 5.0 GB baseline cloud storage
  • 500 quick scans per month
  • Bank transaction synchronization (US, CA, & supported EU institutions)
  • Automatic transaction categorization and matching
  • One-click reimbursement requests
  • Collaborative records and shared access

Storage Packs

Need extra room for high-resolution camera roll images? Paid storage expansions can be purchased to scale your account capacity. These packs stack directly alongside your baseline allowance. They do not stack with other storage packs (purchasing a new tier replaces your active storage pack).

  • 1 GB Storage Pack:(Available to all plans)
    Adds space for ~250–300 uncompressed raw smartphone photos.
  • 5 GB Storage Pack:(Pro users only)
    Adds space for ~1,250 uncompressed raw smartphone photos.
  • 10 GB Storage Pack:(Pro users only)
    Adds space for ~2,500 uncompressed raw smartphone photos.

Platform Fee on Reimbursements

When a reimbursement package is paid, Verity processes the payment through Stripe using destination charges. Stripe deducts its standard processing fees (2.9% + $0.30 for US cards) from the application fee, and Verity's platform net margin is guaranteed at 1% of the transaction total (floored at $0.25-equivalent). The connected account (recipient) keeps everything above this net margin.

How fees work: The platform fee is calculated as Stripe's estimated processing costs (2.9% + $0.30) plus Verity's 1% net margin, floored at $0.25-equivalent. This ensures the platform receives a minimum net revenue after Stripe takes its cut. The exact fee is calculated per-transaction and displayed in the checkout flow before payment confirmation. Verity does not take a percentage cut of transactions beyond this structured fee.

Fee Breakdown

  • Stripe processing fee: 2.9% + $0.30 per successful transaction (for US cards)
  • Verity platform net margin: 1% of transaction total (floored at $0.25)
  • Connected account take-home: Everything above the platform net margin
  • Fees are calculated per-reimbursement-package and shown before payment

Billing FAQ

  • How billing works: Base plan subscriptions and optional Storage Packs are processed as recurring monthly charges. Upgrades take effect immediately.
  • What is the maximum upload limit? Across all plans, the maximum size limit for an individual receipt image or supporting document file is exactly 5 MB. Files that do not match standard document image or PDF types will be rejected.
  • What happens if I hit my 500-scan monthly limit? Your monthly scan allowance refreshes at the start of each billing cycle. If you hit your limit early, native AI processing will pause, but you will still be able to manually upload records and access your dashboard.
  • Do Storage Packs stack? No. Storage packs stack directly on top of your baseline plan allowance, but they do not stack with each other. Buying a new storage pack tier replaces your existing storage pack.
  • Cancelling: You can cancel your Pro plan or Storage Pack subscriptions instantly from your account dashboard. You will retain access to your paid thresholds until the end of your active billing cycle.
  • What happens if I downgrade my storage? If you downgrade your account or drop a storage pack and your active file volume exceeds your new threshold, you will still be able to read and view all your data, but new file uploads will be locked until space is cleared or expanded.
  • Changes to pricing: Any future adjustments to structural baseline limits or monthly subscription fees will be communicated transparently prior to implementation.

Still have questions? Contact support for clarification on pricing and billing.
